description: Change some auto apply settings. Give only the sections to change, in the shape get_auto_apply_settings returns; a section given replaces that section, so read first and send it back whole with your change. Full automatic, Auto-apply mode and which sources it applies from can't be changed here: the user turns those on at https://oceanofjobs.com/apply/settings. Change only what the user asks. Needs the user signed in, with Auto apply settings (write).
name: update_auto_apply_settings
title: Change auto apply settings
